name: outcome-metrics
description: Micrometer outcome observations and cardinality guardrails with Spring Boot and Quarkus adapters.
description_good_justification: README.md succinctly describes Micrometer outcome observations and cardinality guardrails for Spring Boot and Quarkus.
interact_justification: README and GitHub provide obtain (Maven Central / clone), feedback (issues), and contribute (CONTRIBUTING.md + PRs).
contribution_justification: https://github.com/rabitem/outcome-metrics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md documents issues, PRs, DCO, and review.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md and .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md list verify, tests, CHANGELOG, and DCO requirements.
documentation_basics_justification: README.md plus docs/handbook/ cover install, usage, and design.
documentation_interface_justification: Javadoc on public APIs; handbook documents OutcomeObservations and config keys.
sites_https_justification: GitHub and documentation links use HTTPS.
repo_track_justification: Git with full history on GitHub.
repo_interim_justification: Work lands via pull requests to main.
repo_distributed_justification: Git Distributed VCS; GitHub is the canonical remote.
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning via Maven versions and v* tags.
version_tags_justification: Release tags use v* (see .github/workflows/release.yml and tag ruleset).
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md; GitHub Releases populated from changelog sections.
english_justification: Documentation and UI strings are in English.
report_process_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md and issue templates describe bug/feature reporting.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting enabled; see SECURITY.md.
build_justification: ./mvnw -B verify builds and tests the multi-module Maven reactor.
build_floss_tools_justification: Maven, OpenJDK/Temurin, and GitHub Actions are FLOSS.
test_justification: JUnit Jupiter unit tests under outcome-metrics/src/test.
test_most_justification: Core API behaviors covered by unit tests (tags, filters, observations).
tests_are_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md and PR template require tests for new/changed behavior.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL default security queries for Java.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every PR to main and weekly.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Jazzer harness in fuzz/ plus .clusterfuzzlite/ JVM builder.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials in repo; CI uses GitHub Actions secrets; GitGuardian checks on PRs.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed via HTTPS Maven Central / GitHub.
crypto_published_justification: Library does not implement cryptographic protocols.
crypto_call_justification: No application crypto; not in scope for this metrics library.
crypto_random_justification: Project does not generate security-sensitive random values.
crypto_used_network_justification: Library itself does not open network connections for its core API.
hardened_site_justification: No separate project-operated website beyond GitHub.
OSPS-AC-01.01_justification: GitHub organization/user enforces 2FA for account access; collaborators use MFA-capable GitHub auth (passkeys/TOTP).
OSPS-AC-02.01_justification: GitHub default collaborator permissions are least privilege; additional rights granted manually.
OSPS-AC-03.01_justification: Repository ruleset Protect main requires PRs; direct commits to default branch blocked. See .github/RULESETS.md.
OSPS-AC-03.02_justification: Ruleset blocks deletion of the default branch.
OSPS-BR-03.01_justification: Official project URIs (GitHub, docs) are HTTPS-only.
OSPS-BR-03.02_justification: Distribution via Maven Central and GitHub Releases over HTTPS; artifacts cosign-signed on release.
OSPS-DO-01.01_justification: README.md and docs/handbook/ document how to use the software.
OSPS-DO-02.01_justification: SECURITY.md documents the vulnerability reporting process.
OSPS-GV-03.01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md and DCO workflow define contribution requirements.
OSPS-LE-02.01_justification: LICENSE is MIT at repository root.
OSPS-LE-03.01_justification: License clearly stated in LICENSE and README.
OSPS-QA-01.01_justification: Public Git repository on GitHub with full history.
OSPS-QA-02.01_justification: CI workflow runs ./mvnw verify on pull requests.
OSPS-QA-05.01_justification: JUnit tests exercise core library behavior.
OSPS-QA-05.02_justification: CI required status checks must pass before merge.
OSPS-SA-01.01_justification: CodeQL static analysis on PRs and schedule.
OSPS-SA-02.01_justification: OpenSSF Scorecard workflow publishes supply-chain results.
OSPS-SA-03.01_justification: Jazzer fuzz harness and ClusterFuzzLite layout under fuzz/ and .clusterfuzzlite/.
